checks: Live release-pinned yeast search and five-product discovery.
Cancellation after transferred bytes removed only its partial download and published no reference.
Five reference files unpacked atomically with matching receipts; all five independently pinned compressed and expanded hashes agree.
Socket-denied restart listed local references, matched a typed input and generated reference-aware methods.
Completed CWL export preserves the real downloaded yeast reference receipt, input hash, frozen plan and native output provenance.
Offline native SAMtools indexed all 17 yeast contigs and preserved the reference, frozen identities and completed methods.
Installed application and starter pack integrity checks passed after reference use.

Live NCBI exact GCF_000146045.2 lookup discovers genome, GTF and protein only; all three downloaded compressed/expanded identities match independently dated pins with MD5 and gzip verification and observed annotation metadata retained.
A socket-denied fresh host reuses the downloaded NCBI genome through its compatible FASTA input and retains provider/accession provenance in reviewed methods.

Exact packaged transfer code pauses after a production chunk, publishes no incomplete record, reopens and rehashes its checkpoint, truncates an uncheckpointed crash suffix and resumes with exact Range/If-Range into independently verified complete bytes; deterministic provider fixture only.
Malformed Content-Range and changed entity validators are never appended; deterministic responses force a fresh full request whose final bytes still match the independently pinned fixture.
Changed checkpointed compressed bytes and malformed checkpoint JSON fail closed; explicit discard removes only pending state and preserves ready bundles and unrelated user content.

Socket-denied exact private host reviews without copying; stale/replayed review tokens and changed reviewed files fail closed; explicit confirmation copies FASTA and gzip GTF with independently checked source/expanded hashes and clearly user-declared provenance.

Socket-denied typed selection rejects GTF for a FASTA input; reviewed relocation copies and verifies the library while retaining old paths/receipts and exact queued companions. The previously frozen old-path plan then executes native SAMtools with the correct FASTA dictionary and unchanged reference provenance in methods, plan, results and CWL.
A fresh socket-denied private host reopens the relocated local library and offers its verified FASTA to a compatible native tool without contacting either provider.

diagnosis: Native NCBI discovery succeeded, but the new validator incorrectly expected Download to enable before any file was checked. The gate now asserts it is initially disabled, explicitly toggles the genome checkbox and then requires it to enable.

A newly reached service source regression exposed ordinary 8.3 versus resolved long Windows path comparison before the manager call. Service and transfer now compare canonical identities while retaining the requested IO/display spelling and rejecting links before transfer resolution.

Independent inspection of captured native controls found the saved relocated default folder was not populated on first References open. The native edit now initializes empty and is populated from the saved backend destination; first-open and reopen assertions were added.

visualInspection.observation: Three NCBI rows are visible and unchecked; disabled Download is correct. Saved destination is visibly the old app-local default, which requires a separate UI fix.

limits: Live provider suites fully passed; management stopped after six checks and does not establish native management completion.
Windows source stopped after four invocations: 65 passed, one Linux-adapter skip, one service error. Eleven remaining source suites were not executed.
No release or updater was built.
